UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Personalized learning profile, study goals, streak analytics, and commercial subscription tier for an authenticated user.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the user.

displayName.description: User display name from Google profile or custom study nickname.

email.description: Verified Google account email address of the user.

targetTopikLevel.description: Learner's target Korean proficiency level for personalized AI examples.

preferredContextStyle.description: Default AI sentence generation context style for this learner.

dailyGoalWords.description: Target number of Korean words to master per day (between 3 and 50).

streakDays.description: Consecutive study days completed by the user.

totalLookups.description: Cumulative count of AI vocabulary lookups performed by the user.

totalSentencesChecked.description: Cumulative count of practice Korean sentences checked by AI.

totalGamesCleared.description: Cumulative count of 10-word elimination games completed.

subscriptionTier.description: Commercial membership tier of the user.

lastStudyDate.description: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of the most recent study activity.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was last updated.

SavedVocabularyItem.title: SavedVocabularyItem
SavedVocabularyItem.description: A Korean-Vietnamese vocabulary word with 2 bilingual AI example sentences, mastery status, and personal study notes saved in the user's cloud notebook.

vocabId.description: Unique document identifier for the saved vocabulary entry.

userId.description: Owner Firebase Auth UID matching the parent user document.

koreanWord.description: Korean Hangul headword in dictionary form.

romanization.description: Revised Romanization of the Korean word.

hanjaOrigin.description: Hanja characters and Sino-Vietnamese reading or native Korean indicator.

vietnameseExplanation.description: Detailed Vietnamese explanation of usage and cultural nuance.

masteryLevel.description: Learner's current mastery state for this word.

personalNote.description: Custom personal mnemonic or note written by the learner.

isSelectedForGame.description: Whether this word is currently selected for the 10-word elimination game.

synonyms.description: Up to 10 Korean synonyms with brief Vietnamese meanings.

antonyms.description: Up to 10 Korean antonyms with brief Vietnamese meanings.

collocations.description: Up to 10 common Korean-Vietnamese collocation objects.

examples.description: Bilingual Korean-Vietnamese example sentence objects generated by Gemini AI.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the vocabulary item was saved.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the vocabulary item was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile, study goals, streak metrics, and commercial plan settings strictly accessible only by the authenticated owner.

/users/{userId}/vocabularies/{vocabId}.description: User-owned subcollection of saved Korean-Vietnamese vocabulary items, bilingual examples, mastery states, and personal notes.
